content.value: A copy of the Pile after near-deduplication. Pythia paper: 'a copy of the Pile after applying near-deduplication with MinHashLSH and a threshold of 0.87 ... After deduplication, the deduplicated Pile is approximately 207B tokens in size'. Derivation from the Pile is recorded here in prose because Stemma has no dataset-to-dataset edge; the parent is the record `the-pile`.
